g.title: 📌 A Pack member who fails costs the Pack nothing. This is the whole trick.
📌 Any one success carries the entire Pack. Which one does not matter.
📌 Failure here is not waste — it is the price of covering ground the others did not.
📌 Each link must hold for the next to matter.
📌 One disagreement, one dropped hand-off, and everything downstream is lost.
📌 The outcome is unreachable once any single link has gone.
